description: Included instructions (L1 and L6, 4.1.0). By default an included file's :::agent block is carried into a section read of another section, as the document's own is. A host that sets included instructions off keeps that block out of every view: a pointer stands in its place, the block's text does not appear, and the manifest records an included-instructions omission in the included file. The document's own agent block is carried either way.

requests.name: section Work carries the document's and the included file's agent blocks by default
section Work with included instructions off keeps the included block out and records it
the full view with included instructions off keeps it out too
